sources.title: さよならを教えて 攻略 (shisnap)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed Japanese PC walkthrough: common days 1-3, day-4 save, all five heroine routes and day-9 branch choices, day-11 endings, three save positions and one CG variant note. The walkthrough does not name its edition explicitly and appears to reflect the original Windows PC game; direct applicability of its literal choices and all ending behavior to the 2016 DLsite download edition remains UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』（2001）プレイ感想 (kqck, DLsite purchase)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed first-hand Japanese 2026 play log: author says the copy was purchased on DLsite and explicitly recounts the day-9 five-way heroine-selection prompt, selection of 御幸 and movement to 図書室, heroine-specific episodes and ending, plus a failed 望美 attempt that reached the bad ending and required replay from day 3. Important partial independent evidence for the Windows DL distribution, but product ID and all literal route-defining choices, affinity requirements, and endings are not verified; DOES NOT QUALIFY AS COMPLETE SET B.

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～ (ゲームカタログ@Wiki)
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese release/system source: original 2001 PC, 2011 BD, 2016 Windows DL release; five heroine locations; up to three heroine progress tracks before day 9; the normal route ending requires choosing the heroine with whom the player is most familiar at the late branching decision. Prints a day-5 three-choice example and confirms choices may not match what the protagonist actually says. Supports gate-relevant preselection affinity behavior but NOT all exact choices, save states, or individual endings.

sources.title: さよならを教えて | みこりすと
sources.notes: Independent Japanese completed-playthrough report lists five heroine routes and a personal completion order, but not a full actionable choice-by-choice guide. Cannot fill the Set-B gate.

sources.title: DLsite VJ009745 (Windows download edition)
sources.notes: Exact-edition product identifier/URL. Direct page inspection blocked by browsing, but multiple independently inspected Japanese pages reproduce and link this exact product number. The 2016 edition uses a rewritten Windows 10 compatible engine and changes some presentation effects; its exact choice sequences and CG equivalence to the original PC edition still need verification.

sources.title: 〖ギャルゲー〗さよならを教えて | 雨雲レーダー

sources.title: さよならを教えて 感想 - こんこんちきな日記

sources.title: ゲーム「さよならを教えて」感想｜はずき

sources.title: さよならを教えて — 腕がビリビリ (2016 DL edition review)

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』全CGタイトル一覧 — AQL日記 (2016-07-25)

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～』感想、考察 — エロゲ日記（仮） (2022)

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～の感想・考察 — えす山の日記 (2023)
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese written day-by-day play report (common days 1–11, day-9 late branching, heroine-specific Mutsuki reflections and route ending); independent evidence for overall day progression and a main ending. The author explicitly says routes other than Mutsuki were skimmed. It does not list literal choice texts, save states, affinity flags, or every heroine's executable path, and does not establish exact VJ009745 release. sources.title: 〖さよならを教えて〗巣鴨睦月ルート〖終〗 — 私だ (2018, five-route written play diary)
sources.notes: Directly inspected first-hand Japanese written article (and links to author's five-route 2018 diary series). Author initially hit BADEND after attempting 睦月, explicitly says heroine favor was insufficient, restarted from the beginning and then completed 睦月's route. Independent supporting evidence that choosing the day-9 girl alone may fail; NOT a choice-by-choice route guide, does not show exact actions needed to repair the affinity, and does not prove the exact 2016 VJ009745 edition. Supplementary B only.

sources.title: さよなら… 今、全ての人に贈る最期の言葉。— 孤高の在り処 (written five-route review)
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese written all-character review: author says saves made after entering a heroine route display that heroine's name, and the heroine paths reuse the same ending and epilogue with individual route-text variations. Mentions actual in-game selectable phrase フェラチオさせる also present in Set A's Koyori-related day-5 subscene, without specifying all preceding state/sequence. No complete route choices or exact 2016-edition identification; supplementary B only. Do not infer a save-slot label before branch selection.

sources.title: さよならを教えて — 積まないためのゲーム日記 (2013 completion review)
sources.notes: Independent 2013 written Japanese completion report predates the 2016 target. Reports BAD then heroine-branch clears and quotes all three options of the recurring angel-dream response including 彼女は天使であって天使ではない and 絶対に違う！ that appear in abbreviated form in Set A. Partial literal-choice corroboration for an older build only; cannot establish 2016 VJ009745 parity or cover the five route paths. Supplementary B, not a full independent route walkthrough.

disagreements:
AUTHOR DRAFT STATE (2026-11-03; supersedes older research-only statements below): Five route_*.json files and guide.json are now present following the owner's instruction to proceed with drafts. Every guide route remains reviewed:false. Each current main path now identifies the source-reported day-10/day-11 automatic continuation and heroine ending in the last step's enGuide rather than inventing a selectable END menu item. Miyuki's day-5 archery-club sequence is still incomplete and must not be treated as an executable full route. All current jpGuide2 omission markers document absent source evidence, not a qualifying independent Set B for main-route choices. The original A1/A2 gates remain OPEN: no second written-Japanese complete choice-level verification lane, and no verified exact-choice equivalence for VJ009745. The optional bad-end path remains source-unverified and omitted. As a consequence these are explicitly UNREVIEWED DRAFTS; independent structural and accuracy review cannot PASS under the current VN authoring standards, and the PR must stay draft/unmerged until these gaps are resolved. No video evidence used.

HISTORICAL RESEARCH RECORD (the older instruction not to create route files reflects the research phase before the explicit draft override and is superseded as a status statement):

RESEARCH GATE BLOCKED — WRITTEN JAPANESE SOURCES ONLY. The 2016-01-29 Windows DLsite VJ009745 download edition is the persisted exact target. Set A (shisnap) is a detailed Japanese PC walkthrough of the common opening, five heroine paths, save positions and main endings, but it does not identify its original game build. Textual Japanese Set B components independently corroborate the five heroines, late heroine-selection condition, selected endings and the download edition's system differences; NONE documents every route-defining choice, prerequisite/affinity state, and main ending. Therefore the two-source research gate is not met. Do not create route_*.json or guide.json or set reviewed:true. Independently verifiable written Japanese choice-by-choice coverage and version reconciliation are required; recordings, streams, gameplay clips, video transcripts and descriptions must not be used as evidence.

The day-9 heroine selection depends on earlier interactions/affinity. The first-hand Japanese DLsite purchase report documents a five-way day-9 choice and both a normal heroine ending and failed heroine attempt; it does not reproduce the full choices or prove the precise product ID. The Japanese Game Catalogue describes visiting the heroine in earlier days to gain sufficient familiarity; treat these as structural corroboration, not substitutes for executable paths. Do not confuse CG/recollection titles with choices.

Set A documents saves at day 4 (save 1), day 9 (save 2 for the Mutsuki/Mahiru branch) and day 9 (save 3 for the Miyuki/Koyori branch). The download edition allows saving on choice menus, unlike the original PC version; this is an interface difference, not proof of choice/ending equivalence. Proposed route order favors reuse of these source-backed checkpoints and is not a universal spoiler-minimizing narrative order. No mandatory heroine unlock order is established by the written sources.

Optional non-main BAD END detour is not yet reproducibly documented by a Japanese written choice-to-terminal path. It may be omitted while completing the five main routes if their independent source gate is satisfied; do not invent a badEndPath. Reports mention the bad ending and speculate about its trigger, but speculation is not sufficient.

Exact-edition cover lookup was attempted and no reliably attributable 2016 VJ009745 cover was verified, so catalog.cover_url remains blank rather than substituting art from another edition. A Chinese-language ending guide is not Japanese Set B. A Japanese 2022 report describes uncertain CG differences between editions; absent verifiable comparison do not assert original-game route parity.

IMPORTANT: This research-only draft must not be merged because tools/catalog.mjs requires guide.json with new catalog.json. Written-source research has not passed the gate; the independent accuracy review remains CHANGES REQUESTED. No video or recorded gameplay source is retained as evidence or a recommended follow-up. Seek a second independent Japanese written walkthrough, or an explicit repository-owner-approved change to the standards before proceeding.

ADDITIONAL WRITTEN-SOURCE SEARCH (2026-11-03): targeted Japanese search for alternate complete walkthroughs with heroine names, day-9 choices, and route charts found the same shisnap walkthrough as the only complete actionable source. Newly inspected independent written full-completion impressions (note.com/alura_p/n/n868ccb2d863b) and retrospective (ameblo.jp/exitanz0727/entry-12648181697.html) corroborate five heroine branches and general structure but do not provide the literal full choice-to-ending sequences or verify the 2016 build. They are supplementary B, not qualifying. No recordings used. Source A1/A2 remain blocked.

WRITTEN SOURCE PARTIAL-STRUCTURE FINDING (2026-11-03): Independent Japanese 2023 day-by-day play log at mt-ss.hatenablog.com/entry/2023/01/14/030535 gives a common-day chronology through day 11, identifies the day-9 branch and separately narrates Mutsuki's path, but the author skimmed other routes and gives no literal options or replayable saves. It corroborates timing/structure only, NOT the exact choice-level Set B gate. Search results also included non-Japanese full-route descriptions, which are excluded by the Japanese-only source rule. No videos were consulted.

WRITTEN EVIDENCE AUDIT (2026-11-03): 2018 Japanese five-heroine written diary confirms an attempted 睦月 selection can lead to BADEND if previous heroine affinity is insufficient, and replaying from the start can correct it (nekojumpoo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1629.html). A separate Japanese all-route review says a save after entering an individual route displays the heroine name and that heroine paths share the same epilogue (perfectalone.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-116.html). Game Catalogue Wiki likewise calls out a shared main ending across the five heroine route variations, separately from BADEND. Treat 'five route clears' and 'two ending patterns' as distinct, not contradictory, and do not fabricate distinct end states. An independent 2013 written completion review (sakurakameo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-126.html) reproduces several early angel-response option texts that also appear abbreviated in Set A, but it predates the 2016 Windows DL edition and does not provide full branching. This is genuine partial independent TEXT corroboration, not complete route-by-route proof. Written-only exact-choice searches still return shisnap as the only complete runnable chart; no video sources used. A1/A2 remain BLOCKED, and saving at heroine choice screens is supported for the 2016 DL edition, but a route-specific save must be AFTER successful heroine entry to rely on that game's character labeling.
